Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and audit-period clarification

Hi Neha / Redwood team,

We're kicking off procurement for our vendor security review and need your latest SOC 2 Type II report and confirmation of the audited period. Our target audit window for controls testing is Feb 1, 2025 - Jan 31, 2026; please confirm whether your Type II report covers that window or if you can provide a bridge letter.

If the report isn't exactly that window, can you also confirm:
- Whether a bridge letter is available and what it covers;
- Preferred secure transfer methods for the report and any supporting artifact index;
- A short list of typical artifacts you can provide (log samples, retention policies, access-control snapshots);
- Any timelines for delivery — procurement needs materials by 2026-06-18.

We have opened ticket PROC-1542 for tracking (internal). Let me know the best way to receive the files (S3 presigned link, Box, secure SharePoint, etc.).

Thanks,
Laura Peters
Sr. Security & Procurement
Acme Analytics

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear ask and the PROC ticket reference. Happy to help.

Short answers up front:
- If our most recent SOC 2 Type II report includes the Feb 1, 2025 - Jan 31, 2026 window we will provide the full report PDF and auditor opinion.
- If the window doesn't align, we can provide a Bridge Letter that explains coverage and any temporal gaps.

What we can share (typical package):
- SOC 2 Type II report PDF (redacted where appropriate)
- Auditor opinion/engagement letter (PDF)
- Bridge letter (if needed) — we provide a short formal statement summarizing coverage and dates
- Evidence index (CSV) listing artifact names, date ranges, and transfer location; we can include sampling locators for logs and config snapshots
- Sample log excerpts (redacted) and retention policy excerpts
- DPA and related compliance links

Preferred transfer options:
1) Secure S3 presigned link (valid for 7 days) — recommended for large bundles
2) Encrypted Box/OneDrive share with company domain restriction
3) Secure SharePoint site (for customers using Microsoft tenancy)

Attached are a couple of quick artifacts to accelerate your intake: SOC2-Transfer-Instructions.pdf (secure transfer steps), Evidence-List-Template.csv (we'll populate), and a Bridge-Letter-Sample.docx we can adapt if needed.

Please confirm the exact audit window you require (you mentioned Feb 1, 2025 - Jan 31, 2026). If that is the window, we'll run an evidence check and aim to deliver by 2026-06-15 to meet your procurement deadline.

Suggested short reply you can paste into your ticket: "Redwood confirmed SOC 2 Type II will be provided or bridged; delivery ETA 2026-06-15 via presigned S3 link."

Let me know if you want the full evidence index up front or prefer a staged delivery (report first, artifacts on request).

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
